policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Gambia short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance grants Norwegian citizens visa-free entry to Gambia for stays up to 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Norwegian passport holder, short stay of up to 90 days.
Employment, residence, special travel documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Trinidad and Tobago short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance grants Norwegian citizens visa-free entry to Trinidad and Tobago for stays up to 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Norwegian passport holder, short stay of up to 90 days.
Other visa types, residence, special travel documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance expressly permits Norwegian visitors to purchase a Jordanian visa at the airport or border crossings.
conditions: Ordinary Norwegian passport holder; purchase the visitor visa at an airport or land border crossing.
The separate Ministry of Interior online route and Jordan Pass pre-travel purchase do not displace this arrival-issuance route.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Iran advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Norway's current guidance requires Norwegian visitors to obtain an Iranian visa through an embassy or consulate; Iran's official portal confirms that electronic submission is only the first application step and describes a visa sticker.
conditions: Obtain the visitor visa before travel through the Iranian embassy or consulate process. The online form alone is not the issued visa.
The treatment of dual Iranian nationals, work, residence, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Turkmenistan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance requires a visa for entry to Turkmenistan and directs Norwegian applicants to Turkmenistan's embassies before travel.
conditions: Obtain the visitor visa before travel from the designated Turkmenistan embassy process.
Special border-area permission, work, residence, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Djibouti tourist visa issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance confirms that Norwegian visitors can purchase a tourist visa at arrival in Djibouti.
conditions: Ordinary Norwegian passport holder; a tourist visa may be purchased at arrival.
The recommended separate pre-travel online application and non-tourist routes do not displace the visitor arrival-issuance route.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Guinea-Bissau advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance requires a visa for Norwegian visitors to Guinea-Bissau and directs the application to its embassy in Brussels.
conditions: Obtain the visitor visa before travel through Guinea-Bissau's embassy in Brussels.
Work, residence, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Sierra Leone visitor visa issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance expressly permits Norwegian citizens to obtain a Sierra Leone visa at arrival.
conditions: Ordinary Norwegian passport holder; visitor visa may be obtained at arrival.
The alternative official pre-travel eVisa route, airport security levy, work, residence and special-document routes remain separate.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: Niger advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Norwegian Foreign Ministry guidance requires Norwegian visitors to obtain a Niger visa through its embassy before travel and does not support border issuance.
conditions: Apply at Niger's embassy in Copenhagen in good time before travel; border issuance cannot be expected.
Work, residence, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Iran visa on arrival. Current Norwegian guidance requires an Iranian visa through an embassy or consulate, while Iran's own portal says online submission is only the first step and describes a visa sticker.
The fallback labels Guinea-Bissau visa on arrival, but current Norwegian guidance requires Norwegian citizens to deliver their visa application to Guinea-Bissau's embassy in Brussels before travel.
